newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiang invites Blair to China, both pledge new ties.
newsitem.headline: Jiang invites Blair to China, both pledge new ties.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair on Monday urged China to forget the battles of the past and build a new relationship with Britain after the handover of Hong Kong to Beijing.
China's President Jiang Zemin invited Blair to China for an official visit and the two were at pains to stress this was a golden opportunity for closer ties.

"We want a relationship based on the 21st century, putting the battles and struggles of the past behind us," Blair told Jiang during a 45-minute meeting before Britain handed back Hong Kong after 156 years of colonial rule.
Blair, earlier given a warm reception by the people of Hong Kong, told the Chinese leader: "Hong Kong can become a bridge rather than a barrier between Britain and China."
"This is an historic moment for China, Britain and Hong Kong and it can mark a new beginning in our relationship," Blair said in the meeting, shown live on television.
